scientific_change: none: models, data, loss, candidate generation, N128/H5, cost, success criteria, repeats and families unchanged
existing_artifacts: Never recompress, overwrite or delete original source/data/checkpoints/success/failure/raw/PDF history to make space. New codec files have new paths and external SHA receipts.

raw.applies_to: all E2 original episodes, all shared E1 physical futures, all eight new-family episodes and fresh replay mismatch/error prefixes
raw.format: p5-lossless-raw-xz-v1: numeric NPZ plus complete JSON diagnostics XZ preset6
raw.retain: every StepResult including all substep states/times, requested/applied actions, actual dt, final observations, explicit observation times/schema/validity and transition validity, ragged offsets, nonfinite payloads and full initial snapshot
raw.integrity: exclusive create; fsync; external receipt SHA binds NPZ and XZ; pair-internal NPZ SHA; partial writes retained as INCOMPLETE
raw.durability_limit: Codec writes a completed prefix; current executor accumulates in RAM. No power-loss recovery or per-interval durable persistence claim. Disk guard must preauthorize next whole-cell output.

boundary_witness.applies_to: all E2 originals, required actual fresh controller reruns and all new-family episodes
boundary_witness.format: unchanged logical p5-controller-boundary-witness-v1; multi-member gzip forming a single valid JSON document
boundary_witness.retain: all decisions including unexecuted terminal decision, action boundaries, requests/applied actions, time/state/task/holding/validity/termination/context/RNG and candidate/prediction/selection identities
boundary_witness.normal_fresh: Must recompute controller and execute fresh physics. Only a matching, source-bound witness may reference the retained original raw/plan archive; source-file SHA and actual rerun comparison are retained. Recorded actions must never drive the fresh controller.
boundary_witness.scope_limit: Boundary replay PASS alone does not prove all raw substeps or diagnostic bytes identical. Original archive remains original evidence; full fresh per-index equality is claimed only if typed arrays are directly compared.

plan_per_index.applies_to: every original E2/new-family learned decision, including partial invalid and all-invalid/unexecuted terminal decisions
plan_per_index.format: one lossless ZIP_STORED archive per episode, with compressed NPZ per tick plus manifest hashes/dtype/shape
plan_per_index.identity: original N128 ordering and +inf/nonfinite entries preserved; no filtering or valid-only renumbering
plan_per_index.fresh_reuse_requirement: Driver compares complete per-index typed arrays with original before reuse if it claims equality; any per-index difference prohibits a blanket identical-index claim and saves fresh index/full trace within diagnostic allowance before STOP/review. This connection is not yet implemented.

full_plan_arrays_and_inputs.extra: all-invalid terminal decision at its original tick, union-deduplicated with normal ticks; at most one per episode
full_plan_arrays_and_inputs.retain: original N128 candidate actions, full predicted states/deltas, costs/masks/reasons/failure steps, selected identity and complete predecision physical/task/planner/G/RNG input snapshot
full_plan_arrays_and_inputs.partial_invalid: Per-index record is retained for every decision. Partial invalid is not a trigger to save all N128xH5 arrays at every tick. Regeneration uses retained raw boundary, prior context, model/config/source and RNG hashes; an observed mismatch requires an additional full trace and prefix under the diagnostic cap.
full_plan_arrays_and_inputs.missing_tick: Mark unavailable if task ended before tick; never replace with another successful case. E1 still requires actual G ticks0/29 and blocks E1 completion when absent.
full_plan_arrays_and_inputs.G_input_captures: three predeclared slots per G original/fresh/new episode, 25 episodes*3=75 conservative slots; tick299 extra beyond E1 requirement is for consistency
full_plan_arrays_and_inputs.scope_limit: No full-array archive at every ordinary decision; exact offline regeneration coverage remains an integration check, not already proven for a final 300-step execution.

mismatch_error_missing.required: fresh full executed raw prefix, witness, fresh per-index/full trace needed to diagnose difference; retain every failure and denominator
mismatch_error_missing.exhaustion: Stop before next output would exceed allowance, preserve current evidence, reestimate and resolve required reruns; do not drop cases, relax replay tolerance or silently restart. This is not a bound on all possible failures.

resource_guards.planning_multiplier: 1.5, empirical planning allowance and not a proven upper bound
resource_guards.before_stage_and_cell: Remeasure free, reprice all remaining counts with larger observed rates, require full remaining estimate and next-cell output to leave reserve, check hashes and mismatch capacity; otherwise STOP_PRESERVE_PREFIX
resource_guards.RAM: One worker and one cell at a time; final driver+codec combined peak and cleanup still require bounded integration measurement before batch. No 96-cell result accumulation in RAM.
resource_guards.connection: pure calculator/stop checker tested; actual batch wiring remains required

this_G2_operation.allowed: existing-record reads, codecs, pure arithmetic/tests, documentation/PDF/QA
